content:
{'Apple Watch 提供大量自訂錶面讓你個人化手錶，而當中廣受歡迎的 Modular 模組錶面將喺 watchOS 27 變得更加多變。': 'Apple Watch offers a wide range of customisable watch faces so you can personalise your timepiece, and the popular Modular watch face is set to become even more versatile in watchOS 27.'}

{'watchOS 27 為 Modular 錶面新增 13 種顏色選擇，並加入更多功能複雜功能': 'watchOS 27 adds 13 new colour options for the Modular face and introduces more functional complications.'}

{'Modular 一直以來都係 Apple Watch 嘅熱門錶面，憑藉其多功能同豐富嘅自訂選項。': 'Modular has long been a popular Apple Watch face, thanks to its versatility and rich customisation options.'}

{'呢個錶面相當受歡迎，Apple 甚至推出咗 Modular Compact、Modular Ultra 等衍生版本，最新仲有 Siri Modular。': 'The face is so popular that Apple has even launched variants such as Modular Compact and Modular Ultra, with the latest being Siri Modular.'}

{'但標準版「Modular」亦不斷改良。喺 watchOS 26 入面，Apple 為呢個錶面新增咗 13 種顏色選項，方便用戶自訂。': 'But the standard "Modular" face has also been continuously improved. In watchOS 26, Apple added 13 new colour options to this face, making it easier for users to customise.'}

{'以下係 Modular 喺 watchOS 26 嘅全新顏色：': 'Here are the new colours for Modular in watchOS 26:'}

  • {'橄欖綠': 'Olive Green'}
  • {'酒紅': 'Wine Red'}
  • {'沙色': 'Sand'}
  • {'洋紅': 'Magenta'}
  • {'淡雅綠': 'Sage Green'}
  • {'野花藍': 'Wildflower Blue'}
  • {'海軍藍': 'Navy Blue'}
  • {'淺赭': 'Light Ochre'}
  • {'淺藍': 'Light Blue'}
  • {'石灰白': 'Limestone'}
  • {'駝色': 'Camel'}
  • {'鼠尾草綠': 'Sage'}
  • {'桑葚紫': 'Mulberry'}

{'自訂 Modular 錶面時，去到顏色設定頁面就可以喺 watchOS 26 入面搵到以上所有顏色。你亦可以捲動到最底，撳「+」按鈕以「點擊新增更多顏色」嘅方式瀏覽並加入之前嘅顏色。': 'When customising the Modular face, you can find all of the above colours in the colour settings page in watchOS 26. You can also scroll to the bottom and tap the "+" button to browse and add previous colours via "tap to add more colours."'}

{'除咗呢啲新顏色之外，Modular 亦受惠於 Apple Watch Ultra 3 同 Series 11 獨佔嘅最新複雜功能。': 'In addition to these new colours, Modular also benefits from the latest complications exclusive to Apple Watch Ultra 3 and Series 11.'}

{'複雜功能適用於每日步數、心率同準備程度等多種尺寸，等你可以直接喺錶面上追蹤重要嘅健康指標。': 'The complications come in various sizes for daily steps, heart rate, readiness and more, so you can track important health metrics directly on the watch face.'}

{'你最鍾意邊一款 Apple Watch 錶面？歡迎留言分享。': 'Which Apple Watch face is your favourite? Feel free to share in the comments.'}
